sub_sector.value: Electrical distribution and control equipment; electrical equipment services

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures circuit breakers and assembles integrated power distribution and control systems.

production_model.detail: Builds custom-engineered systems for customer projects and fits retrofit assemblies to existing installations.

product_complexity.detail: Custom-engineered, integrated systems for electrical distribution and control, with retrofit assemblies matched to existing equipment.

production_role.detail: Single-source supplier of finished power distribution systems, with commissioning, maintenance and replacement parts.

end_market_exposure.detail: Supplies power distribution systems for industrial applications, offshore oil and gas production, and renewables.

notes: The production model for standard replacement breakers is unclear.
